prompts: Recreate this facade as a wider architectural photograph. Preserve the entire translucent gabled facade, its door, both ancient pale stone columns, weathered surrounding masonry and the stone sculpture. Step the camera back and extend the setting naturally to both sides. The full gable and column tops must fit comfortably with sky margin and foreground paving. Do not crop any key architectural element.

Recreate this kitchen as a wider architectural photograph. Preserve raw concrete ceiling and walls, brushed stainless steel cabinets, sculptural silver pendant lights and the rough-hewn stone island with metal top, sink and cooktop. Step camera back so the COMPLETE island including base, pendant fixtures including ceiling mounts, cabinets and left window are visible with breathing room. Extend the room naturally sideways. No cropped island or lamps.
